title: Guimbal Cabri G2 (Asobo)
sources: Cockpit input events enumerated from MSFS 2024 12.2.282174.999 (SimConnect EnumerateInputEvents), preset cabri_g2_flightseeing
MSFS2024/minimalcache/fs24-asobo-aircraft-cabri-g2/minimal.fsarchive, en-us.locpak: the aircraft's English tooltips and checklist clues (unencrypted archive)
MSFS2024/Packages/asobo-vcockpits-instruments-helicopters/html_ui/Pages/VCockpit/Instruments/Helicopters/AS_EPM/dist/AS_EPM.js: the simulation variables the engine monitor reads
MSFS2024/Packages/asobo-input-profiles-pc/InputProfiles/Categories/Helicopter: the K: events the sim binds for helicopters

entries.name: XMLVAR_ROTORCRAFT_Clutch_Cover_Opened
entries.note: Asobo rotorcraft template (Rotorcrafts.xml): the state of the cover over the clutch switch (the switch works only while it is 1). Not tried.

entries.name: ROTOR_CLUTCH
entries.note: The sim's checklist says: "Engage clutch and lock the switch, CLUTCH light must light on"; "Switch clutch off" at shutdown. Asobo rotorcraft template (Rotorcrafts.xml): sends ROTOR_CLUTCH_SWITCH_SET, state (A:ROTOR CLUTCH SWITCH POS, Bool). Which value is ON is not confirmed. Not tried.

entries.name: COMMON_ROTOR_CLUTCH_COVER
entries.note: Asobo rotorcraft template (Rotorcrafts.xml): the cover over the clutch switch; its state is the L: variable XMLVAR_ROTORCRAFT_Clutch_Cover_Opened, and the switch only works while the cover is open. Which value is ON is not confirmed. Not tried.

entries.name: ROTOR_CLUTCH_SWITCH_TOGGLE
entries.note: Asobo rotorcraft template (Rotorcrafts.xml): what the covered clutch switch sends. Not tried.

entries.name: ROTOR_GOV_SWITCH_OFF
entries.note: Asobo rotorcraft template (Rotorcrafts.xml): what the governor switch sends when it is set to OFF. Not tried.

entries.name: ROTOR_GOV_SWITCH_ON
entries.note: Asobo rotorcraft template (Rotorcrafts.xml): what the governor switch sends when it is set to ON. Not tried.

entries.name: ROTOR_BRAKE
entries.note: The sim's checklist says: "Pull rotor brake lever fully backward, check that indicator is On, then lock rotor brake lever fully forward"; the rotor can be braked below 150 RPM. Asobo rotorcraft template (Rotorcrafts.xml): the lever sets ROTOR_BRAKE_SET and reads (A:ROTOR BRAKE HANDLE POS, Percent). Not tried; the range is not known.

entries.name: ENGINE_AUTO_SHUTDOWN
entries.note: One of the K: events the sim binds in its helicopter control profiles. Not tried on the Cabri. Stops the engine by the sim's own procedure; do not press it in flight.

entries.name: ENGINE_AUTO_START
entries.note: One of the K: events the sim binds in its helicopter control profiles. Not tried on the Cabri. Starts the engine by the sim's own procedure; do not press it in flight.

entries.name: PROCEDURE_AUTO_START_SHUTDOWN
entries.note: The sim's own engine autostart and shutdown (MSFS 2024). Not tried; do not press it in flight.

entries.name: ENGINE_GOVERNOR
entries.note: Tooltip in the aircraft: "Toggle governor switch". Asobo rotorcraft template (Rotorcrafts.xml): ON sends ROTOR_GOV_SWITCH_ON, OFF sends ROTOR_GOV_SWITCH_OFF, state (A:ROTOR GOV SWITCH POS, Bool); the checklist's GOV OFF light is lit when it is off. Which value is ON is not confirmed. Not tried.

entries.name: ENGINE_MAGNETO
entries.note: The sim's checklist says: "Switch plasma and magneto switches off" at shutdown. Asobo engine template (Engine_Inputs.xml): a magneto of type ON/OFF sends MAGNETO1_SET 0 or 3. Which value is ON is not confirmed. Not tried.

entries.name: ENGINE_MASTER
entries.note: Tooltip in the aircraft: "Master". Which circuit it switches is not documented. Which value is ON is not confirmed. Not tried.

entries.name: ENGINE_PLASMA
entries.note: The sim's checklist says: "Switch plasma ignition on and check beeper". Asobo engine template (Engine_Inputs.xml): sends PLASMA_SET 0 or 1 and reads (A:PLASMA ON:1, Bool). Which value is ON is not confirmed. Not tried.

entries.name: ENGINE_STARTER
entries.note: The sim's checklist says: "Press starter button, STARTER light must light on, then back off". Asobo engine template (Engine_Inputs.xml): a starter sends TOGGLE_STARTER and reads (A:GENERAL ENG STARTER:1, Bool). Not tried: whether it needs the button held is not known.

entries.name: ENGINE_MIXTURE
entries.note: The sim's checklist for this aircraft never names a mixture control. Not tried; the range is not known.

entries.name: ENGINE_THROTTLE
entries.note: The sim's checklist says: "Turn throttle fully right", "Set throttle lever to get NR around 530 RPM". Asobo engine template (Engine_Inputs.xml): the throttle set takes the position on a 16k scale (THROTTLE1_SET, (A:GENERAL ENG THROTTLE LEVER POSITION:1)). Not tried; the range this event takes is not known. For an axis use the Helicopter throttle of the Control list.

entries.name: DEICE_CARB_HEAT
entries.note: The sim's checklist says: "Set carburetor heat switch on COLD" and "on HOT" (the NR drops when it is set to HOT). The input list has COLD, AUTO and HOT. Which value is which is not confirmed. Not tried.

entries.name: FUEL_VALVE

entries.name: AS_650_FREQ
entries.note: Tooltip in the aircraft: "Toggle between COM and NAV". AS650.xml: a short push flips the knob between COM and NAV (L:AS650_NAV_Freq_Modify), a long push swaps the standby and active frequency. Not tried: a long push needs a held button.

entries.name: AS_650_FREQ_MHZ
entries.note: AS650.xml: the sign of the value picks the direction (above 0 = WHOLE_INC, 0 or less = WHOLE_DEC) of the COM or NAV radio, whichever the knob is set to. Not tried.
